answer: Before an agent may meter billable work, the state weights and measures office checks the NTEP certificate of conformance on its meter against the lead seal serial recorded at installation and the annual tolerance report. A seal serial found on two meters trips a condemnation order, voids the certificate and calls the operator bond. A type evaluation costs 1800, the inspector seal 75 and the annual test 140, so N fakes cost N x 2015 and each still needs a meter on site. A violet tag on the housing, a ferrous plate on the frame and a river gauge on the wall do not make the seal new.
